verdict.rationale: Amplitude's own docs say Experiment SDKs let you flag and test features across web, mobile, and backend, which covers the multi-stack SDK part of the story. The pack does not name specific SDKs or languages, and nothing addresses consistent flag evaluation across those SDKs. missing for 10: list of specific official SDKs/languages, evidence of consistent flag evaluation behavior across SDKs (e.g., shared evaluation engine or local/remote parity), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use official SDKs across my whole stack — backend, web, and mobile — with consistent flag behavior
